verdict.rationale: Lever publishes developer documentation for a public Data API at https://api.lever.co/v1. The docs list endpoints such as creating and listing applications and listing audit events, and cover OAuth, webhooks, a dedicated integrator sandbox API and a stated field-compatibility commitment. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and evidence of endpoint depth beyond section headings (sandbox access is also partner-gated rather than self-serve).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
